resources.string: Use extracted game images. Extract ZIP and 7z archives before importing.
CIA and ZCIA packages are installed before launch. Encrypted games require your own system keys.
DS and DSi-enhanced cartridges run in DS mode. DSi-only games require a DSi runtime.
FDS games require an 8 KiB disksys.rom BIOS in the firmware folder.
DOL and ELF executables may require choosing their console before launch.
